card.name: Unit abbreviations split after numbers
card.fires_on: The first or middle piece of a unit abbreviation written right after a number, such as mo, bu, mi, the d in mg/dL or IU/d, and ol in mmol/L. It fires where the unit is cut into pieces and the rest is still to come.

modes.label: Split mg/dL
modes.description: The d or slash piece inside mg/dL or IU/d after a lab or dose value.
modes.example: (serum creatinine of up to approximately 3 mg<</d>>L)

modes.label: Other split units
modes.description: The opening piece of a unit such as bu (bushels), mi (miles), mo (months) or mmol after a number.
modes.example: grow 60 or even 85<< bu>>. per acre yields

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare word-start pieces and away from common continuations, with no clear link to meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on the half-written unit right after a number, like the "d" in mg/dL or the "bu" in bushels.
